### CH01-SCN-001 · Woman Cooking Outside Her Door

|---|---|

| Scene category | AMBIENT NPC SCENE |
| Canon status | **PROPOSED** |

- **Physical description.** Three hearth stones and a pot on swept earth in front of a house.
- **What the player sees.** A woman stirring a pot, smoke rising straight, a child carrying sticks.
- **What the player can interact with.** Greet her; she answers without stopping.
- **Can the player enter the space?** Not an interior. Open exterior space the player walks through.
- **NPCs present.** One woman, one child.
- **NPC activities and routines.** Cooks at dawn and dusk; goes to the farm between.
- **Time-of-day variations.** Day and night states required. NPC presence follows the routine above.
- **Weather variations.** Dry and rain states.
- **Gameplay relevance.** None required. Ambient life; no reward, no quest.
